name: Technical Design Report for the Upgrade of the ALICE Time Projection Chamber
notes: This TDR itself (cds.cern.ch/record/1622286) could not be fetched in this session: CDS returned only an 'Anubis' bot-protection challenge page on every attempt (no title/abstract/date recovered from it), so no source record was created for that URL and it is not cited as a `sources` entry (an uncitable/failed fetch may not be cited per A18). The report number, its 2013 LHCC submission year and its subject (replacing the MWPC-based TPC readout with GEM-based, continuous, ungated readout for Run 3) are corroborated instead by arXiv:1511.04988, an ALICE Collaboration paper actually fetched this session describing the same GEM-based TPC upgrade project. `confidence: uncertain` reflects that the TDR document itself was not directly read.

summary.plain: The plan to rebuild ALICE's Time Projection Chamber with new gas detectors so it can read out data continuously at much higher collision rates, installed for LHC Run 3.
summary.technical: ALICE TPC upgrade TDR (CERN-LHCC-2013-020, ALICE-TDR-016, 2013): replaces the original MWPC-based TPC readout chambers with GEM-based Micro-Pattern Gaseous Detectors enabling continuous, ungated readout at the Pb-Pb interaction rates (up to 50 kHz) expected in LHC Run 3.
